question: Independent pixel remeasurement of the reported 1930s dimming
observations: The target is detected at its propagated/registered position on five independent Hamburg plates. Secondary photometry has the expected dimming/recovery direction, but no event plate passes the complete corroboration gate.
material_limits: Primary quadratic response cannot be reliably calibrated on event plates.
Secondary isotonic response was chosen after seeing primary failure and is exploratory.
At least one near-normal control is absent in1937; its physical or instrumental cause has not been established. Conditional held-out RMS omits unscored stars.
Magnitude results use static catalogue colour in each plate natural system; no event colour history or cause is established.
Blank-noise-only bounds are not validated stellar confidence limits.
next_useful_work: Diagnose comparison-star failures with orthogonal scans and larger local calibration fields before promoting a historical magnitude estimate or a physical explanation.
